name: neurology
description: Datenpaket für Neurologen: Migräne-Sessions, Symptome, HIT-6, MIDAS
description_en: Data package for neurologists: migraine sessions, symptoms, HIT-6, MIDAS

queries.migraine_episodes: SELECT date, ts_start, ts_end, severity, duration_h, aura, nausea, vomiting, photophobia, activity_impact, type, medication, notes FROM migraine WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY ts_start
queries.headache_assessments: SELECT ts, date, instrument, score, details FROM assessments WHERE person = :person AND instrument IN ('HIT-6','MIDAS') AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY ts
queries.neuro_symptoms: SELECT date, symptom, value_num, value_text, category, source FROM symptoms WHERE person = :person AND (symptom LIKE '%Kopf%' OR symptom LIKE '%Migräne%' OR symptom LIKE '%headache%' OR symptom LIKE '%dizziness%' OR symptom LIKE '%Schwindel%' OR symptom LIKE '%aura%' OR category LIKE '%Neuro%') AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date
queries.apple_headache_events: SELECT date, ts, value, source_app FROM measurements WHERE metric IN ('headache','memory_lapse','dizziness') AND person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY ts
